name: Noonday Descent: The Path of Listlessness and Torpor
source: A satiric epistolary visual novel about three Noonday Demons giving advice to a new member of their ministry. They work together to teach her the only thing they know: how to tempt humans and damn souls efficiently.
translation: 一部带有讽刺意味的书信体视觉小说，讲述三名正午恶魔向部门里一位新成员传授经验的故事。它们合力教给她自己唯一擅长的事：如何高效地诱惑人类，让灵魂堕入地狱。
